log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Mamoswine

decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Aero (222 Spe) + Weavile (194 Spe): outspeed Lopunny-Mega (max 205) and Talonflame (max 195); Rock Slide OHKO Talonflame (4x SE), ~20% on Lopunny; Weavile Fake Out Talonflame blocks Gale Wings Brave Bird. Back Gholdengo + Araquanid: Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Fake Out/Taunt and walls special attackers (Kingambit, Milotic); Araquanid Water Bubble+Mystic Water Liquidation 2x SE on Mamoswine, bulky enough to function without TR. Incineroar/Hatterene stay home.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Mega Lopunny (Scrappy, 135 Spe), Talonflame (Gale Wings, Focus Sash), Milotic (Competitive), Mamoswine (Life Orb, Thick Fat), Kingambit (Defiant, BlackGlasses), Scrafty (Intimidate, Roseli). Plan: Fast mode lead Aero+Weavile handles Lopunny/Talonflame core. Gholdengo is mandatory back (Good as Gold is game-changing). Araquanid without TR is slow but Water Bubble nuke is worth it. If game 2/3 needed, pivot to TR mode with Hatterene+Araquanid. Watch for Scrafty Intimidate on switch-in (drops Atk). Kingambit Defiant punishes Intimidate users.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega is Lopunny. Lopunny and Talonflame lead to deny immediate pressure with Fake Out while Talonflame establishes Tailwind or Taunts Trick Room. Mamoswine supplies strong Ice/Ground coverage into Aerodactyl and Gholdengo, while Kingambit is the late-game cleaner and punishes Intimidate with Defiant.
decisions.notebook: Future plan: preserve Mega Lopunny and Talonflame's fast-mode utility; use Mamoswine to pressure opposing Flying and Steel threats, while reserving Kingambit for a protected late-game cleanup. Watch for Trick Room and double-Fake-Out openings.

decisions.rationale: Mega Aero Rock Slide spreads 4x SE STAB on Talonflame (75*2*4*0.75 = 450 effective BP, near-OHKO even through spread reduction) plus neutral chip on Lopunny. Weavile Fake Out on Talonflame has priority +3, breaks its Focus Sash and forces flinch, denying Tailwind setup and Brave Bird turn 1. Tough Claws locked now boosts future Crunches. Lopunny's only Fake Out on Aero is NVE 0.5x, harmless. My Aero (200) outspeeds Lopunny (137-172) pre-mega; Weavile (194) also outspeeds Lopunny. Talonflame lose
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead Aero+Weavile vs Lopunny+Talonflame. Turn 1: Mega Aero Rock Slide + Weavile Fake Out Talonflame (sash break + flinch, 4x SE AOE). Plan: dismantle Lopunny/Talonflame pivot core. Tough Claws locked. Roster: Mega Lopunny Scrappy 170-205 Spe post-mega, Talonflame Gale Wings Focus Sash, Milotic Competitive Bold Leftovers, Mamoswine Life Orb Thick Fat Adamant, Kingambit BlackGlasses Defiant Adamant, Scrafty Roseli Intimidate Careful. If game 2/3 needed, pivot to TR mode with Hatterene+Araquanid if opp doubles down on speed. Scrafty Intimidate drops Atk on switch-in; Kingambit Defiant punishes. Gholdengo Good as Gold stays back as anti-status/status-move pivot. Araquanid Water Bubble nuke needs TR support or slow matchup.

decisions.rationale: Mega Fake Out targets the immediate Rock Slide threat; if Lopunny wins the priority tie, Talonflame safely establishes Tailwind. Even if Weavile Fake Outs Lopunny, Talonflame remains able to Tailwind. This preserves the fast-mode plan and avoids accepting a free 4x Rock hit.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny and Talonflame's Tailwind utility for fast-mode control. Mamoswine pressures opposing Flying and Steel threats; Kingambit is reserved for protected late-game cleanup. Opponent has revealed Pressure on Aerodactyl and Weavile. Watch for Trick Room and double-Fake-Out openings.

decisions.rationale: Rock Slide guaranteed OHKOs Talonflame (4x SE 90-213% range) and chips Lopunny ~10-23%. Aero 222 Spe outspeeds both foes so Rock Slide moves first unless flinched. Switching Weavile to Gholdengo brings in a Fighting-immune wall that hard-counters Loppuny for the rest of the game; even if Loppuny Fake Outs Aero to prevent Rock Slide, Gholdengo still walls and Talonflame is threatened next turn. Preserves Weavile sash for late-game cleaner.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead Aero+Weavile vs M-Loppuny+Talonflame. Turn 1: M-Aero Rock Slide readied, Weavile Fake Out broke Talonflame sash+flinch. Turn 2 plan: Rock Slide OHKO Talonflame (4x SE confirmed), switch Weavile to Gholdengo pre-emptively to wall Loppuny (immune to HJK/Fake Out via Ghost). Opp roster confirmed: M-Loppuny Scrappy Jolly 170-205 Spe, Talonflame Gale Wings Sash Jolly 160-195, Milotic Bold Competitive Leftovers, Mamoswine Adamant Thick Fat LifeOrb, Kingambit Adamant Defiant BlackGlasses, Scrafty Careful Intimidate RoseliBerry. If game 2/3 needed, consider TR mode with Hatterene+Araquanid if opp doubles down on speed. Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Atk drops. Gholdengo Good as Gold anti-status pivot. Araquanid Water Bubble needs TR support.

decisions.rationale: High Jump Kick is the strongest immediate answer to Weavile, though Focus Sash may leave it at 1 HP. Talonflame must Protect because Aerodactyl’s Rock Slide is a severe spread threat and Tailwind is unsafe while speed order is uncertain. This preserves both fast-mode pieces for the next turn.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny and Talonflame as the primary fast-mode core; Tailwind remains valuable after Talonflame is protected from Rock Slide. Mamoswine is the preferred reserve pressure piece against opposing Flying and Steel threats. Kingambit remains a late-game cleanup option. Opponent has revealed Pressure on Aerodactyl and Weavile and may leverage priority or speed uncertainty.

decisions.rationale: Rock Slide 4x SE OHKOs sashless Talonflame at 84% (98.9-190.2%), removing Tailwind setup. Gholdengo Focus Blast 2x SE on Lopunny-Mega (72.7-134.3% range); after Rock Slide chip Lopunny sits at ~55-65% so Focus Blast always KOs if it connects. Aero can survive most HJK rolls (66.8% survival). Aggressive tempo to clear both opponents.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead Aero+Weavile, Gholdengo pivoted in turn 2 to wall M-Loppuny. Opp roster: M-Loppuny Scrappy Jolly 170-205 Spe (HJK hits Gholdengo at 0.5x via Scrappy bypassing Ghost), Talonflame Gale Wings Sash Jolly 160-195 (sash broken), Milotic Bold Competitive Leftovers, Mamoswine Adamant Thick Fat LifeOrb, Kingambit Adamant Defiant BlackGlasses, Scrafty Careful Intimidate RoseliBerry. Rock Slide 4x SE confirms OHKO on Talonflame without sash. Focus Blast 2x SE on Loppuny is the key nuke but 70% acc. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status, walls HJK at 0.5x. If game 2/3, consider TR mode with Hatterene+Araquanid; Araquanid Water Bubble needs TR. Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Atk drops so avoid self-debuffing Crunch into them.

decisions.rationale: Triple Axel is a guaranteed knockout on Aerodactyl despite its resistance, while Brave Bird is a guaranteed knockout on Gholdengo. This removes both active threats immediately; Talonflame acts before Gholdengo, and leaving Lopunny unprotected is worthwhile to secure the double knockout.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny and Talonflame as the primary fast-mode core. Tailwind is valuable once Talonflame is protected from Rock Slide. Mamoswine is preferred reserve pressure against Flying and Steel threats; Kingambit is a late-game cleanup option. Opponent has revealed Pressure on Aerodactyl and Weavile and may leverage priority or speed uncertainty.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine is the stronger immediate reserve: it pressures both active foes, especially the weakened Flying threat, while Lopunny retains Protect or Triple Axel pressure. Kingambit is safer defensively but gives Gholdengo and Aerodactyl more room to control the turn.

Mamoswine High Horsepower is a guaranteed OHKO on Gholdengo (confirmed). Gholdengo Protect guarantees survival against the most likely opposing line (Mamo HH into Gholdengo). Aero Rock Slide applies spread pressure: 0.5x on Lopunny at 64% and neutral on Mamoswine, with flinch chance. This maintains Gholdengo's offensive threat for next turn while chipping both foes. Speed tie between Gholdengo (104) and Mamoswine (100-132) makes attacking with Gholdengo too risky.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Aero+Weavile lead, Gholdengo pivoted in turn 2 vs M-Lopunny. Talonflame fainted turn 3 to Rock Slide (4x SE). Mamoswine entered turn 3. Lopunny at 64% HP, Scrappy confirmed (HJK would hit Gholdengo). Mamoswine Adamant LifeOrb ThickFat brought specifically to counter Gholdengo with High Horsepower (guaranteed OHKO). Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status, walls HJK at 0.5x via Scrappy. Focus Blast 2x SE on Mamoswine but 70% acc. Make It Rain 2x SE OHKOs Mamoswine but speed tie risk. If game 2/3, consider TR mode with Hatterene+Araquanid; Araquanid Water Bubble needs TR. Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Atk drops so avoid self-debuffing Crunch into them. Milotic Bold Competitive Leftovers in back.

decisions.rationale: Lopunny’s Protect removes the speed-risk Rock Slide line and preserves the fast win condition. Mamoswine’s priority Ice Shard is a guaranteed KO on Aerodactyl from its shown 85%, even if Aerodactyl moves first. This forces Aerodactyl to Protect while keeping Lopunny safe.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny as the primary fast-mode win condition. Mamoswine’s priority Ice Shard is strong pressure against Flying threats, while Kingambit remains a late-game cleanup option. Opponent may exploit speed uncertainty and priority with Aerodactyl and Weavile; protect the fast core from Rock Slide when possible.

decisions.rationale: Aero at 5% HP will die to Mamoswine Ice Shard; Protect (full success, no prior use) saves it. Gholdengo Make It Rain is 2x SE Steel STAB 120 into Ice/Ground Mamoswine — easy OHKO even with 0.75x spread. Lopunny Shadow Ball immune and Focus Blast 70% acc unreliable, so spread Make It Rain also pressures Lopunny at 64%. Preserves Aero for next turn and removes the dedicated Gholdengo counter.
decisions.notebook: G1: Aero+Weavile lead, Gholdengo pivoted in vs M-Lopunny. Talonflame fainted turn 3 to Rock Slide. Mamoswine Adamant LifeOrb ThickFat brought as Gholdengo counter (HHorsepower 2x SE OHKO). Lopunny Scrappy confirmed. Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status, walls HJK. If G2/G3 consider TR mode (Hatterene+Araquanid Water Bubble). Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Atk drops — avoid Crunch into them. Milotic Bold Competitive Leftovers in back.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Ice Shard acts before Aerodactyl and guarantees its KO. Lopunny’s reduced-success Protect is still the best line: it blocks Weavile Fake Out and preserves the fast win condition while Gholdengo cannot freely punish it. Triple Axel risks Fake Out, its 90% accuracy, and Gholdengo Protect.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny as the primary fast-mode win condition. Mamoswine’s priority Ice Shard reliably removes weakened Flying threats, while Kingambit is the fallback cleanup option. Opponent has repeatedly favored Aerodactyl Rock Slide; protect the fast core from spread damage and Weavile priority when possible.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Aerodactyl moves before Lopunny and Rock Slide guarantees its KO from 1%, while also threatening Kingambit. Gholdengo's Focus Blast is a guaranteed OHKO on Kingambit despite its -2 Special Attack. Protecting or switching Aerodactyl leaves Lopunny free to use super-effective Triple Axel.
decisions.notebook: G1 revealed Lopunny has Scrappy; Gholdengo's Good as Gold reliably blocks its status options while walling High Jump Kick. Opponent brought Adamant Life Orb Mamoswine as a Gholdengo counter, but it was removed. For later games, consider the Hatterene + Araquanid Trick Room mode; account for Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant before using Attack drops.

decisions.rationale: Protect preserves Lopunny from Fake Out and spread damage. Kowtow Cleave is a guaranteed OHKO on Gholdengo, removing its Focus Blast threat regardless of Aerodactyl’s action. This preserves Lopunny as the fast endgame condition.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny as the primary fast-mode win condition. Opponent favors Aerodactyl Rock Slide and can use Protect to disrupt priority-based finishes. Gholdengo has revealed Focus Blast and Make It Rain; Kingambit is vulnerable to Fighting attacks, so remove or avoid Gholdengo when possible.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl moves before both foes, and Earthquake is 100% accurate and KOs either 1% target unless it Protects. Gholdengo Protect avoids allied Earthquake damage and Kingambit's Dark attacks. Lopunny can no longer Fake Out after remaining active since turn 1; its next consecutive Protect also has reduced success.
decisions.notebook: G1 revealed Lopunny has Scrappy; Gholdengo's Good as Gold reliably blocks its status options while walling High Jump Kick. Opponent brought Adamant Life Orb Mamoswine as a Gholdengo counter. Opponent repeatedly uses Lopunny Protect under pressure, including consecutive attempts. For later games, consider the Hatterene + Araquanid Trick Room mode; account for Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant before using Attack drops.

decisions.rationale: Triple Axel is a guaranteed KO on Aerodactyl. Kingambit's Protect covers both Rock Slide and Focus Blast, preserving it to use Sucker Punch next turn; attacking Gholdengo now risks losing Kingambit to the opposing combination. This line accepts Aerodactyl Protect or a faster Rock Slide as the main risks.
decisions.notebook: Preserve Mega Lopunny as the primary fast-mode win condition. Opponent favors Aerodactyl Rock Slide and may use Protect against priority-based finishes. Gholdengo has revealed Focus Blast and Make It Rain; Kingambit is highly vulnerable to Fighting attacks, so remove or avoid Gholdengo when possible.

decisions.rationale: Double-target with two accurate attacks. Sucker Punch can remove at most one attacker, leaving the other to KO Kingambit from 1%. Protect can only delay the finish, while avoiding Rock Slide, Focus Blast, and Make It Rain accuracy risks or Earthquake friendly fire.
decisions.notebook: G1 revealed Lopunny has Scrappy; Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks its status options while walling High Jump Kick. Opponent brought Adamant Life Orb Mamoswine as a Gholdengo counter. Opponent repeatedly Protects under pressure, including consecutive Lopunny attempts and coordinated defensive turns. For later games, consider the Hatterene + Araquanid Trick Room mode; account for Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant before using Attack drops.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch acts before both foes and removes Gholdengo if it attacks, eliminating the revealed super-effective Focus Blast. Aerodactyl is more likely to Protect against priority at 4%, while Gholdengo's Protect success is reduced after last turn. This preserves the best chance to retain Kingambit and avoid the Fighting threat.

reflections.summary: Won by exploiting Mega Lopunny's Protect-heavy play pattern: Aerodactyl-Mega chipped Lopunny with Rock Slide and Gholdengo punished the consecutive Protects with Make It Rain / Focus Blast, trading 1-for-1 the Lopunny-Mamoswine duo. Lopunny's Triple Axel miss on T3 and Talonflame dying to the same Rock Slide sealed the early tempo, and Crunch into Kingambit finished after a double-Protect standoff. The Lopunny-Mega was a poor bring into our Rock Slide + Wide Guard-capable squad and Good as Gold
reflections.adjustment: For game 2 revisit the team preview: Lopunny-Mega is a weak answer to our build and our Lopunny reads (consecutive Protects into Turn 5-6) showed it. Consider dropping Lopunny-Mega for a more synergistic Mega or keep it but pair with a dedicated Lopunny-bait (e.g., spread move + Wide Guard user) rather than stacking Protect users. Against this opponent bring Milotic or Scrafty (not yet seen) to handle Talonflame Tailwind and to add Intimidate / Competitive support, and keep Araquanid for Wide Gu
reflections.notebook: G1 revealed Lopunny has Scrappy; Gholdengo's Good as Gold blocks its status options while walling High Jump Kick. Opponent brought Adamant Life Orb Mamoswine as a Gholdengo counter. Opponent repeatedly Protects under pressure, including consecutive Lopunny attempts and coordinated defensive turns. Opponent's Lopunny-Mega Triple Axel missed T3; Lopunny-Mega was a poor answer to Rock Slide + Wide Guard. Kingambit came in after Mamoswine fell and was forced to Protect under dual pressure, then Sucker Punched a fainted slot. For later games, consider the Hatterene + Araquanid Trick Room mode; account for Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant before using Attack drops. Plan game 2: evaluate bringing Milotic/Scrafty (not yet seen) and reconsider Mega choice given Lopunny's weak performance.

reflections.summary: Lost primarily because the chosen four and Mega Lopunny fast-mode plan matched poorly into Mega Aerodactyl plus Gholdengo. Talonflame was immediately exposed to Rock Slide, Mamoswine could not capitalize through Aerodactyl's Protect, and Kingambit was left vulnerable to revealed Focus Blast.
reflections.adjustment: Rework the preview selection rather than defaulting to Talonflame and Mamoswine beside Mega Lopunny: bring a sturdier answer to Mega Aerodactyl and a safer Gholdengo check, or choose a different Mega if the available roster cannot support Lopunny's fast mode into this matchup.
reflections.notebook: Opponent's Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly pressures with Rock Slide and uses Protect to deny priority-based finishes. Gholdengo has revealed Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect, making Kingambit an unreliable direct answer. Reassess the Mega Lopunny fast-mode plan against this core; Talonflame plus Mamoswine did not provide sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support. Future plans should include a durable Mega Aerodactyl answer and a safer way to pressure Gholdengo.
